methodology: Current pure test fixture builders provide inputs; expected plans/problems are evaluated only from historical Git blobs. Assertions are not executed and this capture is not a PASS result. Four prior Rust planner serialization/move cases and the blueprint delta were additionally captured from byte-identical historical sources before retiring the oracle.
